00050 SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal::SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal(UGen const& inputA, 
00051                                                              UGen const& inputB, 
00052                                                              const int fftSize,
00053                                                              const int initialDelay) throw()
00054 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00055     fftSize_(fftSize),
00056     fftSizeHalved(fftSize / 2),
00057     initialDelay_(initialDelay),
00058     fftEngine(new FFTEngineInternal(fftSize)),
00059     buffers(BufferSpec(fftSize_, NumBuffers, true)),
00060     bufferIndex(initialDelay <= 0 ? 0 : initialDelay >= fftSize_ ? 0 : fftSize_ - initialDelay)
00061 {
00062     inputs[InputA] = inputA;
00063     inputs[InputB] = inputB;
00064 }
00065 
00066 SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal::~SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal()
00067 {
00068     delete fftEngine;
00069 }

00079 void SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00080 {
00081     const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00082     int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00083     
00084     float* inputASamples = inputs[InputA].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00085     float* inputBSamples = inputs[InputB].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00086     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00087     
00088     float* const bufferASamples = buffers.getDataUnchecked(InputA);
00089     float* const bufferBSamples = buffers.getDataUnchecked(InputB);
00090     float* const outputBufferSamples = buffers.getDataUnchecked(Output);
00091         
00092     DSPSplitComplex fftABuffer;
00093     fftABuffer.realp = buffers.getDataUnchecked(ProcessA);
00094     fftABuffer.imagp = fftABuffer.realp + fftSizeHalved;
00095     
00096     DSPSplitComplex fftBBuffer;
00097     fftBBuffer.realp = buffers.getDataUnchecked(ProcessB);
00098     fftBBuffer.imagp = fftBBuffer.realp + fftSizeHalved;
00099     
00100     DSPSplitComplex fftResultBufferSplit;
00101     fftResultBufferSplit.realp = buffers.getDataUnchecked(FFTResult);
00102     fftResultBufferSplit.imagp = fftResultBufferSplit.realp + fftSizeHalved;
00103     
00104     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00105     {
00106         int bufferSamplesToProcess = fftSize_ - bufferIndex;
00107         
00108         if(bufferSamplesToProcess > numSamplesToProcess)
00109         {           
00110             // buffer the inputs
00111             memcpy(bufferASamples + bufferIndex, inputASamples, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00112             memcpy(bufferBSamples + bufferIndex, inputBSamples, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00113             
00114             // ...and the output
00115             memcpy(outputSamples, outputBufferSamples + bufferIndex, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00116                                                 
00117             bufferIndex += numSamplesToProcess;
00118             inputASamples += numSamplesToProcess;
00119             inputBSamples += numSamplesToProcess;
00120             outputSamples += numSamplesToProcess;
00121             numSamplesToProcess = 0;
00122         }
00123         else
00124         {
00125             numSamplesToProcess -= bufferSamplesToProcess;
00126             
00127             memcpy(bufferASamples + bufferIndex, inputASamples, bufferSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00128             memcpy(bufferBSamples + bufferIndex, inputBSamples, bufferSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00129             
00130             memcpy(outputSamples, outputBufferSamples + bufferIndex, bufferSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00131             
00132             bufferIndex += bufferSamplesToProcess;
00133             inputASamples += bufferSamplesToProcess;
00134             inputBSamples += bufferSamplesToProcess;
00135             outputSamples += bufferSamplesToProcess;
00136             bufferSamplesToProcess = 0;
00137             
00138             // do fft           
00139             fftEngine->fft(fftABuffer, buffers.getDataUnchecked(InputA), true);
00140             fftEngine->fft(fftBBuffer, buffers.getDataUnchecked(InputB), true);
00141             
00142             // convolve
00143             memset(fftResultBufferSplit.realp, 0, fftSize_ * sizeof(float));
00144             MultAndAdd(fftABuffer, fftBBuffer, fftResultBufferSplit, fftSizeHalved / 4);
00145                         
00146             // do ifft
00147             fftEngine->ifft(outputBufferSamples, fftResultBufferSplit, true, true);
00148                                                 
00149             bufferIndex = 0;
00150         }
00151     }
00152     
00153 }

00155 SimpleConvolution::SimpleConvolution(UGen const& inputA, 
00156                                      UGen const& inputB, 
00157                                      const int fftSize, 
00158                                      const int initialDelay) throw()
00159 {   
00160     const int fftSizeChecked = Bits::isPowerOf2(fftSize) ? fftSize : Bits::nextPowerOf2(fftSize);
00161 
00162     const int numInputChannels = ugen::max(inputA.getNumChannels(), inputB.getNumChannels());
00163     initInternal(numInputChannels);
00164     
00165     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00166     {
00167         internalUGens[i] = new SimpleConvolutionUGenInternal(inputA, 
00168                                                              inputB, 
00169                                                              fftSizeChecked, 
00170                                                              initialDelay);
00171     }
00172 }
00173 
00174 OverlapConvolution::OverlapConvolution(UGen const& inputA, UGen const& inputB, const int fftSize, const int overlap) throw()
00175 {   
00176     const int fftSizeChecked = Bits::isPowerOf2(fftSize) ? fftSize : Bits::nextPowerOf2(fftSize);
00177     const int overlapChecked = Bits::isPowerOf2(overlap) ? overlap : Bits::nextPowerOf2(overlap);
00178     
00179     UGenArray overlappingConvolutions;
00180     const int delay = fftSize / overlapChecked;
00181             
00182     for(int i = 0; i < overlap; i++)
00183     {
00184         overlappingConvolutions <<= SimpleConvolution::AR(inputA, inputB, fftSizeChecked, delay * i);
00185     }
00186         
00187     UGen mixer = overlappingConvolutions.mix();
00188     
00189     const int numInputChannels = ugen::max(inputA.getNumChannels(), inputB.getNumChannels());
00190     initInternal(numInputChannels);
00191     
00192     for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00193     {
00194         internalUGens[i] = new BinaryMultiplyUGenInternal(mixer, 1.0 / overlapChecked);
00195     }
00196 }
